facts.fact: Burkina Faso's own submission to the UN CSTD says a national AI action plan is being drawn up, covering skills, computing and storage infrastructure, centres of excellence, pilot projects, entrepreneurship and a regulatory and ethical framework.

The government says its universities and research centres are studying over fifty AI solutions, including an automatic French-Mooré translation, transcription and speech platform and the LegiChat legal-text question app, with no release stated.

The document describes the BODI initiative and the data.gov.bf portal but names no open data policy.

facts.fact: The government says its portal data.gov.bf, set up with World Bank support, holds 261 datasets on education, health, ICT and agriculture.

The government says four applications have been developed that reuse the data.gov.bf datasets, and that the BODI initiative led by ANPTIC produced Open Election and the NENDO school-data map on open data.
